verses.1: Alleluia. At the departure of Israel from Egypt, the house of Jacob from a barbarous people:
verses.2: Judea was made his sanctuary; Israel was made his power.
verses.3: The sea looked, and it fled. The Jordan was turned back again.
verses.4: The mountains exulted like rams, and the hills like lambs among the sheep.
verses.5: What happened to you, O sea, so that you fled, and to you, O Jordan, so that you were turned back again?
verses.6: What happened to you, O mountains, so that you exulted like rams, and to you, O hills, so that you exulted like lambs among the sheep?
verses.7: Before the face of the Lord, the earth was moved, before the face of the God of Jacob.
verses.8: He converted the rock into pools of water, and the cliff into fountains of waters.
verses.9: Not to us, O Lord, not to us, but to your name give glory.
verses.10: Give glory to your mercy and your truth, lest the Gentiles should say, “Where is their God?”
verses.11: But our God is in heaven. All things whatsoever that he has willed, he has done.
verses.12: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the works of the hands of men.
verses.13: They have mouths, and do not speak; they have eyes, and do not see.
verses.14: They have ears, and do not hear; they have noses, and do not smell.
verses.15: They have hands, and do not feel; they have feet, and do not walk. Neither will they cry out with their throat.
verses.16: Let those who make them become like them, along with all who trust in them.
verses.17: The house of Israel has hoped in the Lord. He is their helper and their protector.
verses.18: The house of Aaron has hoped in the Lord. He is their helper and their protector.
verses.19: Those who fear the Lord have hoped in the Lord. He is their helper and their protector.
verses.20: The Lord has been mindful of us, and he has blessed us. He has blessed the house of Israel. He has blessed the house of Aaron.
verses.21: He has blessed all who fear the Lord, the small with the great.
verses.22: May the Lord add blessings upon you: upon you, and upon your sons.
verses.23: Blessed are you by the Lord, who made heaven and earth.
verses.24: The heaven of heaven is for the Lord, but the earth he has given to the sons of men.
verses.25: The dead will not praise you, Lord, and neither will all those who descend into Hell.
verses.26: But we who live will bless the Lord, from this time forward, and even forever. [ Psalm 114 ] (116A)
